guide.title: Guide to Ordering Korean Cosmetics Wholesale
guide.subtitle: A simple 5-step guide to ordering authentic Korean cosmetics wholesale at the best prices.

1.title: Step 1: Choose Products
1.desc: Browse the product catalog on our website. You can search by name, filter by category, brand, or minimum order quantity (MOQ). Select products that fit your customer base.

2.title: Step 2: Request a Quote
2.desc: Fill out the wholesale quote request form on our website or contact us directly via Zalo. Provide product names, estimated quantities, and your contact information.

3.title: Step 3: Receive Detailed Quote
3.desc: Within 24 business hours, we will send a detailed wholesale quote including unit prices by quantity, discounts, and shipping information.

4.title: Step 4: Confirm & Ship
4.desc: After agreeing on the quote, confirm the final quantity. We will package to standard and arrange shipping to your address.

5.title: Step 5: Order Complete
5.desc: Receive goods, check quantity and quality. Start your Korean cosmetics business with competitive wholesale pricing.

moq.title: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
moq.desc: Flexible MOQ from 10-48 units depending on product, suitable for starting a business.

discount.title: Volume Discounts
discount.desc: Wholesale discounts increase with order volume — the more you order, the better the price.

warranty.title: Authentic Guarantee
warranty.desc: All products are 100% authentic with full origin certification.

support.title: After-Sales Support
support.desc: Product consultation, marketing images, and materials for wholesale customers.
